title: DualView: Adaptive Local-Global Fusion for Multi-Hop Document Reranking
abstract: arXiv:2605.18767v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires aggregating information from multiple documents, a critical capability for knowledge-intensive applications. A fundamental challenge lies in efficiently identifying the minimal relevant document set from retrieved candidates while maintaining high recall.   We present an efficient dual-view cascaded reranking framework for multi-hop document reranking. Operating as a lightweight post-retrieval stage over E5-base-v2 candidates, our architecture comprises: (1) a Local Scorer employing stacked cross-attention for fine-grained query-document relevance; and (2) a Global Scorer modeling inter-document dependencies via Transformer-based context aggregation. These views are dynamically fused through an Adaptive Gate conditioned on query semantics.   Under the fixed candidate set reranking setting with offline cached embeddings, our model achieves competitive results, particularly outstanding on MuSiQue w

translated_title: DualView：面向多跳文档重排序的自适应局部-全局融合
translated_abstract: 多跳问答需要聚合来自多个文档的信息，这是知识密集型应用的一项关键能力。一个根本性的挑战在于如何从检索候选中高效地识别出最小相关文档集，同时保持高召回率。我们提出了一种高效的双视图级联重排序框架，用于多跳文档重排序。该框架作为E5-base-v2候选结果之上的轻量级检索后阶段运行，其架构包括：(1) 局部评分器，采用堆叠交叉注意力实现细粒度的查询-文档相关性计算；(2) 全局评分器，通过基于Transformer的上下文聚合建模文档间依赖关系。这两种视图通过以查询语义为条件的自适应门控机制进行动态融合。在候选集固定重排序设置（使用离线缓存嵌入）下，我们的模型取得了有竞争力的结果，尤其在MuSiQue上表现突出。
tldr: 提出了双视图级联重排序框架DualView，通过局部评分器（堆叠交叉注意力）与全局评分器（Transformer文档间依赖建模）的自适应门控动态融合，实现高效精准的多跳文档重排序。
en_tdlr: DualView is an efficient dual-view cascaded reranking framework that dynamically fuses a local cross-attention scorer with a global Transformer-based inter-document dependency scorer via an adaptive gate for accurate multi-hop document reranking.
